meta.name: Light as a Feather 2018
meta.description:
Five teen girls deal with the supernatural fallout stemming from an innocent game of “Light as a Feather, Stiff as a Board.” When the girls start dying off in the exact way that was predicted, the survivors must figure out why they’re being targeted — and whether the evil force hunting them down is one of their own.

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 16/16

videos.title: …Stiff as a Board
videos.overview: Four best friends invite the shy new girl out on Halloween, but they soon regret their decision when she suggests they play a twisted version of Light as a Feather, Stiff as a Board.

videos.title: ...Pretty as a Picture
videos.overview: It’s Olivia’s 18th birthday party and McKenna is going with her longtime crush, Henry. But a shocking discovery gives the night an unexpected turn.

videos.title: ...Dead as a Doornail
videos.overview: The girls start to suspect Violet may not be as innocent as she claims.

videos.title: …Dark as the Night
videos.overview: As McKenna investigates Violet, she finds herself haunted by nightmares of her past.

videos.title: …Mad as a Hatter
videos.overview: Violet uncovers crucial information about the girls’ relationship.

videos.title: …Troubled as the Tide
videos.overview: Violet continues her manipulation. Trey is helped by an unlikely ally.

videos.title: …Right as Rain
videos.overview: A dangerous secret about Violet is revealed.

videos.title: …Cold as Ice
videos.overview: Determined to get answers, McKenna devises a new plan.

videos.title: …Innocent as a Lamb
videos.overview: Violet recounts an important story from her past.

videos.title: ...Slippery as an Eel
videos.overview: McKenna has an unconventional proposal.

videos.title: …Lost As Eden
videos.overview: As McKenna’s life starts to spiral, she finds herself turning to an unlikely ally. The girls head to a party where Alex meets a mysterious woman.

videos.title: …Free As A Bird
videos.overview: McKenna and Alex start their court-ordered community service. Violet gives McKenna advice.

videos.title: …Sly As A Fox
videos.overview: McKenna figures out a way to track her sleepwalking. Trey reconnects with an old friend.

videos.title: ...Sick as a Dog
videos.overview: A horrible accident leads McKenna to believe the Light As A Feather game has been played again. Trey performs with Sammi’s band.

videos.title: ...Silent as the Night
videos.overview: McKenna has an unfortunate run-in. Violet and Alex try to find out more about the Light As A Feather game.

videos.title: ...Pale as Death
videos.overview: The girls make a discovery that could lead them to the origins of the game. Isaac and Violet get closer.

videos.title: ...Guilty as Sin
videos.overview: A secret from Violet's past comes back to haunt her. McKenna and Sammi go on a trip.

videos.title: ...White as a Ghost
videos.overview: The girls have a new lead that could fix all their problems -- but to see it through, they will have to risk it all.

videos.title: ...Fresh As a Daisy
videos.overview: It’s New Year’s Eve as the girls anxiously celebrate their return to normal. Trey and Sammi’s band, Bit of Decay, play their biggest show yet.

videos.title: ...Trapped As a Rat
videos.overview: Violet encounters an old friend in the most unlikely of places. McKenna tries to find answers, only to find more trouble.

videos.title: ...Clear As Mud
videos.overview: The girls come up with a new plan that soon causes friction. Trey and Sammi prepare for a huge life change.

videos.title: ...Hungry Like a Wolf
videos.overview: Alex and Peri’s cabin escape takes an unpleasant turn. The rest of the gang struggle to help a friend.

videos.title: ...Thick As Thieves
videos.overview: As the friends turn to an unlikely source for help, one is forced to confront her greatest fear.

videos.title: …Mean As a Rattlesnake
videos.overview: As the stakes escalate, the girls find themselves scrambling to piece together clues.

videos.title: ...Quiet As a Tomb
videos.overview: McKenna pressures a friend to deliver on a deadly promise.

videos.title: …Brave As a Lion
videos.overview: With the curse closing in, the girls must make a tough decision, and one faces a hard truth that could change everything.
